text.b70ffe360073c5: LocaleArc keeps connection, translation, review, and publication visible and under your control.
text.3efeaa03c23c98: Sign in on Google’s consent screen. LocaleArc requests the youtube.force-ssl scope so it can read your channel’s video metadata and update localizations.

text.608cea8ba53bc2: Edit the drafts locally and approve them first. LocaleArc updates approved localized titles and descriptions only when you start the publish action.
text.03a914da3ccc52: Built around your Mac, not a developer cloud.
text.ff69af802b4ad2: No LocaleArc account. Anatolia Apps does not operate a LocaleArc backend that receives your channel data, drafts, or credentials.

text.4e1f4ce6c02485: Local project state. Imported metadata, translation drafts, settings, and operation history are stored on your Mac.

text.8a25185b375d3c: LocaleArc uses YouTube API Services only to identify the channel you authorize, load its uploads and metadata into your local workspace, and read, add, update, or remove video localizations at your direction. It does not upload or delete videos, post comments, or change video visibility.
text.75ee3eb95e6add: Disconnecting in the app asks Google to revoke access and removes locally stored YouTube metadata, drafts, channel identity, activity history, and recovery copies. You can also manage access from Google Account permissions. Removing local data does not remove content stored by YouTube.
text.815b89d3b51060: LocaleArc records each full channel refresh and removes YouTube data that has not been refreshed within 30 calendar days on the next app launch.
text.a38328b9e7555b: LocaleArc’s handling of Google user data is described in the Privacy Policy and is intended to comply with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements.
text.331e5aa68e3805: LocaleArc privacy policy: Google and YouTube data access, local storage, retention, deletion, and third-party processing.
text.b1194d16ebcb16: How LocaleArc accesses, uses, stores, refreshes, and deletes Google user data and other information processed on your Mac.
text.27fe86a0a4f1d8: LocaleArc is a macOS application offered by Anatolia Apps. It helps a channel owner load YouTube video metadata, prepare localized titles and descriptions, review drafts, and publish only approved localizations.
text.2fb5f50e215690: LocaleArc has no developer-operated account system or cloud backend and does not use advertising SDKs or cross-app advertising tracking. Anatolia Apps does not receive your Google credentials, YouTube API data, project files, or AI provider keys. YouTube and AI requests go directly from your Mac to the relevant service. RevenueCat processes purchase information for Pro access and purchase reporting, as explained below.
text.428a12d8f0cc80: LocaleArc uses the YouTube Data API v3 and requests this sensitive OAuth scope:
text.33589b4a4ed588: Google describes this scope broadly because it can permit an authorized client to see, edit, and permanently delete YouTube videos, ratings, comments, and captions. LocaleArc limits its actual use to the product functions described here:
text.2f1d189abefc58: identify the YouTube channel connected by the user;
text.e59e9b74920978: read the channel’s uploads and video metadata, including video IDs, titles, descriptions, language information, thumbnails, publication dates, categories, and existing localizations;
text.55cab61c6c4b45: add, update, or remove localized video titles and descriptions only after a user starts the relevant publish or remove action.
text.713d896bc9725c: LocaleArc does not upload or delete videos, post comments, change ratings, or change a video’s visibility. Google authentication occurs in the system authentication session; LocaleArc never sees your Google password.
text.e9e239aaf35c16: LocaleArc’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements. Use of YouTube API Services is also subject to the YouTube API Services Terms of Service and YouTube API Services Developer Policies.
text.1a3d9b311c9e9b: OAuth credentials. Google access and refresh tokens are stored as generic-password items in macOS Keychain under the service com.localizer.app.secrets.
text.77bb401e151df8: YouTube workspace data. Imported metadata, channel identity, localization state, and translation drafts are stored in the app’s local project state.
text.d93e3de2c7e188: Activity history. A local operation log can contain operation results, error messages, and video titles. It does not intentionally contain OAuth tokens, AI API keys, or Google passwords.
text.fca6b92cb9363b: Recovery copies. LocaleArc keeps a local backup of project state to protect drafts from file corruption. The backup is covered by the same retention and deletion rules as the primary state.
text.f1df14352797cb: Preferences and purchases. App settings and trial state are stored locally. After YouTube data is deleted, trial state may retain only a non-identifying “trial used” flag and the selected trial language; it does not retain a YouTube video or channel identifier. The app also caches an anonymous RevenueCat app user ID and Pro access information locally. App Store payments are processed by Apple; LocaleArc does not receive payment-card details.
text.d3c5af1db0b2d2: In sandboxed App Store builds, project state is inside the app container under Library/Application Support/YouTubeLocalizer/. Existing non-App-Store builds use ~/Library/Application Support/YouTubeLocalizer/. The legacy folder name is retained so updates do not hide existing drafts.
text.2a491e4c407455: 4. AI providers and other third parties
text.9c95c1a62645a8: When you request a translation, LocaleArc sends the source title, source description, target languages, and any translation instructions directly from your Mac to the AI provider selected in Settings: Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or Ollama Cloud. Requests use the API key you provide for your own account. Anatolia Apps does not proxy or receive these requests.
text.e4bc8ee60f4842: Google Gemini. Data use depends on your account, billing status, and region. The Gemini API terms distinguish paid and unpaid services; some unpaid services permit product improvement and human review of inputs and outputs. Check the terms applicable to your account.
text.8e70318c06e501: OpenRouter. OpenRouter routes requests to the model providers used for your selected model. LocaleArc requests providers with data_collection=deny; this is not a guarantee of zero retention. OpenRouter and downstream providers have separate processing, logging, and retention policies described in the provider data policies.
text.946e23cca56e55: Ollama Cloud. This option uses Ollama’s cloud service, not a model running only on your Mac. Content and technical information are processed under Ollama’s Privacy Policy.
text.5d3288e77d1faa: LocaleArc does not determine your provider’s account terms or promise a universal retention or model-training policy. You can write, review, and publish translations manually without sending the source text to an AI provider.
text.f9ff66cf109195: Those providers process information under their own terms and privacy policies. Google and YouTube process OAuth and YouTube API requests under Google’s Privacy Policy. Apple processes App Store purchases and refunds under Apple’s Privacy Policy.
text.f10a9a23d15b95: LocaleArc does not sell Google user data, use it for advertising, transfer it to data brokers, or use it to build advertising profiles. It does not share Google user data with Anatolia Apps or unrelated third parties.
text.f347a17cc035d6: LocaleArc uses RevenueCat to verify App Store purchases, manage and restore Pro access, and provide purchase analytics and reports to Anatolia Apps. When purchase services are initialized, including Pro checks at app startup, the app communicates with RevenueCat using a randomly generated anonymous app user ID. This can occur before you connect YouTube or make a purchase.
text.081201b5bef699: RevenueCat processes purchase history and transaction details, Pro access status, and technical or device information such as app and SDK versions, operating system, device model, preferred language, and App Store storefront. The SDK may include an Apple vendor/device identifier when Apple makes it available. These data support purchase verification, access management, and purchase reporting; they are separate from video translation and publishing.
text.621bf3c6c2afd8: LocaleArc does not send your Google account, YouTube channel or video identifiers, video metadata, drafts, email address, OAuth tokens, or AI API keys to RevenueCat. It does not connect your RevenueCat app user ID to your Google or YouTube identity or send advertising identifiers. Apple handles your payment-card information; neither LocaleArc nor RevenueCat receives those card details through this integration.
text.e90af3b2a3182e: RevenueCat processes this purchase data on behalf of Anatolia Apps to provide the purchase service and reports. More information is available in RevenueCat’s privacy information and its purchase analytics and app privacy guidance. Purchase reporting is separate from the YouTube and AI content flows described above.
text.c1c12f1ad88933: A successful full channel refresh records a local refresh date. YouTube metadata and related drafts may remain available for up to 30 calendar days. On the next app launch, LocaleArc removes YouTube metadata, related drafts, channel identity, and related activity history that have not been fully refreshed within that period before using or displaying them.
text.2d397a68a47bc7: Choosing Disconnect in LocaleArc asks Google to revoke the OAuth token and immediately removes the local OAuth credential, cached YouTube metadata, channel identity, unpublished drafts, related activity history, YouTube identifiers in trial state, and recovery copies. App preferences, local purchase identifiers and Pro access state, and a non-identifying “trial used” flag may remain. Content already published to YouTube is not deleted by clearing LocaleArc’s local data.
text.233ef9d4645570: If Google’s revocation endpoint cannot be reached, LocaleArc still removes local credentials and YouTube data and warns you that Google access may remain active. You can revoke access from Google Account permissions. If access is revoked outside LocaleArc, the app detects an unusable token on the next refresh or API operation and removes the related local YouTube data.
text.84a3d4d6c063f2: Disconnecting YouTube or deleting local app data does not delete purchase records held by Apple or RevenueCat. The 30-day YouTube-data rule above does not apply to purchase records. For questions about purchase data or a deletion request, contact anatolianapps@gmail.com; requests are handled subject to applicable requirements and the records needed to manage purchase rights.
text.dbf11a5c9f380d: Do not connect Google or configure an AI provider if you do not want LocaleArc to access those services.
text.d95269a1dcabe9: Use manual editing instead of AI generation, or remove your AI key in Settings to stop future AI requests. Deleting local data does not delete information already processed or retained by a provider; use that provider’s account controls or contact process.
text.d1b5500d6b371d: Use YouTube Settings → Disconnect to revoke access and delete locally stored YouTube data.
text.1514ff6ac5c302: Use Google Account permissions to review or revoke Google access independently.
text.eb29711aa3b539: Delete LocaleArc and its application container or legacy Application Support folder to remove the remaining local project and preference data. Keychain Access can remove any remaining com.localizer.app.secrets items.
text.7b45e630caf4c8: Important: deleting data stored by LocaleArc does not delete data stored by YouTube. Manage or delete YouTube content through YouTube or another authorized client.
text.6a47a0e77bf14d: LocaleArc uses HTTPS for service requests, PKCE with the OAuth authorization-code flow, a random state value for callback validation, macOS Keychain for credentials, and App Sandbox network-client access. No method of storage or transmission is completely risk-free.
